body:
Fixes #2751.

Dependency updates now enable upstream dependency reporting by default. `/fix owner/repo --update-all-dependencies` includes the reporting paragraph in the generated issue, and `--update-all-dependencies` includes it in all six solver prompts. The paragraph asks the solver to report general logic, duplicated code, missing features, and bugs that require workarounds, with a reproducer and suggested fix or feature proposal. Necessary local workarounds remain allowed so upstream fixes do not block the PR.

`--report-dependencies-issues` independently enables reporting. `--no-report-dependencies-issues`, `--report-dependencies-issues=false`, and `--report-dependencies-issues false` disable it while preserving dependency updates. Explicit choices survive `/fix`, `/hive`, and Telegram `/task` handoffs. The shared paragraph appears once, including with deep analysis.

The [case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2751-3b566158eaa0/docs/case-studies/issue-2751/README.md) records the original root cause, failed reproducer, every requirement, alternatives, existing components, primary-source research, and preserved logs. The [follow-up audit](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2751-3b566158eaa0/docs/case-studies/issue-2751/requirements-audit.md) answers the latest review comment and checks every requirement again. Documentation is updated in English, Russian, Hindi, and Chinese, with an offline example and one minor Changeset.

Merged current `main` and resolved all reported conflicts, preserving its Codex process diagnostics and Docker comments. The current freshness gate also required refreshing both Sentry packages from 11.5.0 to 11.6.0; the paired upgrade retains the native profiler version and has an offline integration smoke check.

## Reproduction and verification

- Original baseline: `node --test tests/report-dependencies-issues.test.mjs` failed on the missing option, omitted generated paragraph, and lost reporting choices. Its complete failed output is preserved in the case study.
- The reporting suite passes all 13 tests, covering default reporting, independent opt-in, opt-out forms, repeated switches, issue creation, `/fix` handoff, Telegram handoff, and all six solver prompt builders.
- The two expanded reporting and hive suites pass 46 tests. Seven new cases exercise the production `/hive` parser, scheduler, and solver argument forwarder using the existing offline fixture; Telegram's seven cases verify both generated body and suggested solve command.
- Real `/fix --dry-run` checks include the paragraph by default and omit it with opt-out, without creating issues or starting solvers.
- The complete default suite passes 581 test files. ESLint, Prettier, duplication, secret scanning, syntax, line limits, documentation validation and language sync, package-manager declaration, Changeset validation, version checks, and dependency freshness pass locally.
- The Sentry pin regression fails before the upgrade and passes afterward; the SDK and native profiling integration initialize and close with an in-memory transport.

Final local results and compressed logs are recorded in [review-validation.json](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2751-3b566158eaa0/docs/case-studies/issue-2751/review-validation.json). Fresh CI passed for final commit `17fbe1a496f6d8549155295a82c82de50239275c`: [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37847286533), [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37847286440), and [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37847286426).
title: Enable upstream dependency reporting during dependency updates
